tools_helpful.evidence: Injected '// TODO[migrate-003]: see PATTERNS.md#background-tasks' on the BackgroundTaskBuilder line (Scenario4_BackgroundActivity.xaml.cs:150), routing the agent to the background-tasks anchor.

tool_limitations.limitation: Pattern '\bIBackgroundTask\b|BackgroundTaskBuilder' matches the builder but NOT 'BackgroundExecutionManager.RequestAccessAsync()' — the actual API that throws at runtime in WinUI 3 desktop — so no TODO was injected on that line and the agent left it unmodified.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Add BackgroundExecutionManager / RequestAccessAsync to the background-tasks pattern so the analyzer flags the runtime-throwing call, not just the builder.

failed_apis.why_tried: UWP 'Register Task' handler requests background access before registering an out-of-process ActivitySensorTrigger task.
failed_apis.root_cause: The old out-of-process background infrastructure (RequestAccessAsync + TaskEntryPoint component + device triggers) is unsupported in WinUI 3 desktop; the call throws. Because the handler is 'async void' with no try/catch, the exception is swallowed and the button appears dead.
failed_apis.fix: Guard the call in try/catch and surface the error via the app's existing NotifyUser status path; migrate registration to WinAppSDK single-process BackgroundTaskBuilder or defer with a visible status message.

doc_errors.wrong: Section only says IBackgroundTask/BackgroundTaskRegistration 'are not the recommended model' and points to the WinAppSDK BackgroundTaskBuilder; it does not warn that BackgroundExecutionManager.RequestAccessAsync() and TaskEntryPoint-based out-of-process tasks THROW at runtime in desktop, nor that the call must be guarded.
doc_errors.correct: State that RequestAccessAsync() / out-of-process TaskEntryPoint tasks / device triggers throw in WinUI 3 desktop and must be wrapped in try/catch that surfaces a status message.

special_apis.special_handling: No WinUI 3 desktop equivalent for the out-of-process model; guard at the call site and surface an error, or move to WinAppSDK in-process BackgroundTaskBuilder.

errors_encountered.error: 'Register Task' invoked in WinUI 3 produces no visible response (dead control); newTokens 0, post-click frame unchanged.
errors_encountered.root_cause: async void ScenarioRegisterTask has no try/catch; BackgroundExecutionManager.RequestAccessAsync() throws in desktop and the exception is silently swallowed.
errors_encountered.fix: Wrap async void event-handler bodies in try/catch and route the exception to the same status UI the handler updates on success.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Kept UWP out-of-process background API verbatim; button silently dead at runtime.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: 1 (TODO at builder line was cleared but the RequestAccessAsync call was left unadapted)
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The injected TODO landed on BackgroundTaskBuilder, but the runtime-throwing call (RequestAccessAsync) was not flagged, and PATTERNS.md#background-tasks gave no runtime-behavior warning; the async void handler hid the resulting exception.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved — shipped as a dead control (feature scored partial).
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: (1) Extend inventory pattern to flag BackgroundExecutionManager/RequestAccessAsync so a TODO is injected on the throwing line; (2) broaden the Defensive-UI rule to require try/catch around async void event handlers that call WinRT APIs, surfacing the error to the UI.

env_issues.issue: Validation machine has no activity sensor; background/sensor APIs are device- and identity-gated.
env_issues.workaround: Handlers must surface a visible status on the no-device / unsupported-API path instead of silently no-op'ing.
